## What the bug was
`AdminSite.catch_all_view()` (introduced in #31747) redirected with `HttpResponsePermanentRedirect("%s/" % request.path)` — appending the slash to the bare path, so any query string (`?id=123`) was dropped from the redirect.

```python
return HttpResponsePermanentRedirect(
    request.get_full_path(force_append_slash=True)
)
```
